shots.visual: 一道紫雷劈落焦土，林昭站在雷坑中央张开双臂，衣袍烧焦，雷光顺着胸口灌进去。
shots.prompt_en: purple lightning bolt striking scorched earth, Lin Zhao standing in center of lightning crater, arms spread wide, burnt robes, lightning energy surging into chest, cracked blackened ground, glowing purple light, dramatic lighting

shots.visual: 荒原雷泽全景，紫色闪电如林立在焦黑大地上，天空低垂翻涌，空气里全是焦味。
shots.prompt_en: panoramic wasteland thunder marsh, purple lightning bolts standing like forest over scorched black earth, low churning stormy sky, drifting ash haze, harsh violet glow, ominous atmosphere

shots.visual: 老墨拄着断杖站在雷光里，抬手指天，对林昭大声喊话，衣袍被狂风撕开。
shots.action: 抬手指天、衣袍被风撕开
shots.prompt_en: old man leaning on broken staff, pointing at sky, shouting, torn robes whipping in wind, standing amid crackling lightning, stormy night sky, dramatic rim lighting

shots.visual: 林昭咬牙仰头，喉间低吼，第二道锁在雷光里崩断，锁链纹把雷光收进骨血，瞳孔变作雷色。
shots.action: 仰头低吼、第二道锁崩断、雷光入体
shots.prompt_en: Lin Zhao, head thrown back, teeth clenched, roaring, second seal shattering in lightning, chains absorbing thunder into bones, pupils glowing lightning-colored, stormy sky, crackling electric arcs, dramatic backlight

shots.visual: 他抬手一挥，掌心雷光凝成一把长刀斜劈出去，整片雷云被从中劈开。
shots.prompt_en: male cultivator, raising hand, lightning gathering into long saber in palm, diagonal slash, splitting thundercloud apart, stormy sky, electric arcs, dramatic backlight, high contrast

shots.visual: 云开天晴，一缕残余雷光落在他肩头蜷成小兽形状，他第一次笑了，眼角挂着泪。
shots.action: 雷光落肩蜷成兽形、他笑起来
shots.dialogue: 林昭：（盯掌心）……它，睁开眼睛了。
shots.prompt_en: clouds parting, clear sky, man, first smile, tears at eye corners, residual lightning curling into small beast shape on his shoulder, glowing sparks, soft sunlight, emotional moment
